query:
SELECT s.duration_seconds AS "duration_seconds!",
               s.avg_viewers::float8 AS avg_viewers,
               s.unique_chatters,
               s.retention_5m::float8 AS retention_5m
        FROM twitch_stream_sessions s
        WHERE s.streamer_login = $1
          AND s.started_at >= $2
          AND s.duration_seconds > 300
